title: How to Automate Schema Markup So AI Assistants Cite You
titleNl: Schema markup automatiseren zodat AI-assistenten je citeren
description: Hand-written schema drifts out of date within months. Here is how to generate JSON-LD from your CMS, product and author data, keep it valid, and measure whether AI models actually cite the pages.
descriptionNl: Handgeschreven schema loopt binnen maanden achter. Zo genereer je JSON-LD uit je CMS-, product- en auteursdata, houd je het geldig en meet je of AI-modellen de pagina's echt citeren.
seoTitle: How to Automate Schema Markup for AI Citations
seoDescription: Automate JSON-LD from your CMS, product and author data so ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini can read, trust and cite your pages. Types, workflow and measurement.
seoDescriptionNl: Automatiseer JSON-LD uit je CMS-, product- en auteursdata zodat ChatGPT, Perplexity en Gemini je pagina's lezen, vertrouwen en citeren. Types, workflow en meting.
